name: Phone feed stop
oneLiner: a metal-and-glass phone rises turning toward camera, its social feed is flicked and rushes up in a blur, decelerates on a long tail and settles on the brand's post, then a double tap blooms a heart on the image, the like fills and the count ticks up
say: when the speaker talks about stopping the scroll or a post blowing up: the feed lands on the post as they name it, the heart pops on 'people loved it'
